capabilities: Locate notes and attachments instantly with keyboard-driven, relevance-weighted search
Index and search text inside PDFs, Office documents, and images via OCR
Filter queries with quoted expressions, -exclusions, and file-type filters like .jpg or .md
Expose vault search to external tools through an opt-in local HTTP server
disambiguation: Unrelated to the omnisearch.ai paid product despite the shared name.
extras: Won the 2023 Gems of the Year award; beta versions install via BRAT and 'can be buggy and break things'; Chinese support needs an additional plugin; a companion browser extension and MCP server integration exist in the ecosystem.
intentEvidence: You can see it as a Quick Switcher on steroids.
problem: Obsidian's built-in search and Quick Switcher don't weight results by relevance, resist typos, or index the text inside PDFs, Office documents, and images.

relations.evidence: Images, documents, and PDF indexing is available through Text Extractor
Silversearch is a fork of Omnisearch for Silverbullet.

summary: Search engine that instantly finds notes, PDFs, Office documents, and images with BM25 relevance scoring, typo tolerance, and OCR-based indexing.
